pk.context: 20 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

tell: Time-dependent kinetics, with higher plasma levels at steady state, and CYP2C19-dependent clearance set this proton pump inhibitor apart.

clues.text: Protein binding is approximately 95%. The drug is extensively metabolized by cytochrome P450 enzymes, mainly CYP2C19, and about 77% of a dose is eliminated in urine as metabolites.
A magnesium salt in a 2:1 ratio, with an active moiety of molecular weight 345.4. It is slightly soluble in water, at 0.25 mg/mL at 25°C.
Supplied under an NDA as 2.5 mg and 10 mg unit dose packets for oral suspension, and given once daily.

Contraindicated with rilpivirine-containing products and in hypersensitivity to the drug or its chemical relatives, with no boxed warning. Headache and abdominal pain are the most common reactions in pediatric patients.
Treatment of active duodenal and benign gastric ulcers, eradication of Helicobacter pylori, gastroesophageal reflux disease and erosive esophagitis, and pathologic hypersecretory conditions.
Specifically inhibits the H+/K+ ATPase of gastric parietal cells, blocking the final step of acid production and both basal and stimulated acid secretion.
The generic name begins with O and has ten letters.
